# NEX — Neural Execution Language

NEX is a checked programming language and toolchain for humans and LLMs.
Current source development is toolchain 0.234.0 / language 0.28 / task ABI 7.
It includes ordinary source contracts and experimental checked scalar Metal
emission with installed owned-provider preparation tools. Complete matching
portable SDK qualification remains pending. The current README links exact
source/device records; older SDK archives keep their own versioned evidence.
Executables run without an LLM. Precise semantics and small retrieved contexts are design goals;
the first local Qwen3.8 27B comparison found no NEX token savings.

- [Installed Metal tool evidence](docs/evidence/macos-installed-public-Metal-tools-0.165.0-2026-11-10.json)

Use `nex describe --kind index --json`, then `--field PATH --json`.
Use `nex context --symbol NAME --json` for bounded project context.
For native hosts, query the bounded
[`native_entry_abi`](docs/native-entry-abi.md) in library build JSON. Retrieve the
actual physical signature and hidden error output; a symbol name alone is not
a host prototype. Discover availability in the selected compiler first.
The selected compiler and actual tests govern support. PLAN and historical
experiments are not implemented capability lists. Current Windows CUDA and CIX
GPU/NPU checks retain their exact source and
ordinary-installation scope. Scalar Metal emission is experimental; broader
GPU/NPU compilation, Apple NPU and complete matching platform/SDK qualification
remain open. Query `gpu_codegen` and `gpu_codegen.owned_provider` before use.
